name: icons
purpose: Inline SVG glyphs. All of them live in one module; no component declares an SVG path inline except the four RBAC button shapes, which are data rather than chrome.
rule: Every icon in this design system is exported from one module. A generator must not inline a new SVG path into a section.

knownException.why: They are per-role readout data (circle / square / triangle / cross), driven by the measured per-role lit-shape set, not reusable chrome.
